summary: The iOS app's speed measurements now use the daemon's histogram bins, so the daemon accepts them; a minute is never reported twice and a refused report is dropped instead of sent forever

replay.detail: Client-only change; no claim replay or recovery behavior. A test in smallclaims pins the bin bounds the app now sends.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; the client report format and its validation are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The app now sends the canonical bin bounds the daemon already required. Measurements an earlier app build kept on the device were never accepted and are discarded on first launch of this build.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent daemon state changes; schema and rules versions are unchanged.
